items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die fehlenden Unterlagen binnen 10 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens ein (Werktage sind Montag bis Samstag, ausgenommen gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: The letter's own date is Friday 27.03.2026, and the period runs 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens' (after the date of this letter), so the letter's date itself is day zero and is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analogy). Counting starts 28.03.2026. 'Werktage' are defined in the letter as Monday to Saturday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting 10 such working days from 28.03.2026 (Sat 28 Mar counts as day 1; no NW public holidays fall in this window) lands on Friday 10.04.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final day: 10.04.2026.

warnings: This is only a request for documents to continue processing a claim, not a formal legal deadline with a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung; missing it risks the insurer deciding 'nach Aktenlage' (on the file as it stands) rather than any statutory penalty.

The IBAN printed (DE78 3705 0198 0001 2345 00) is structurally valid and belongs to a German bank (BLZ 37050198), but this letter does not ask for a payment to that account, so no funds should be sent to it based on this letter alone.
